text: Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers; Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction, Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese Please click here to download the timetable of subjects Professional Emphases Jiangsu University offers two majors within the CEPM program. -Civil Engineering, involving the design and construction of buildings and bridges. -Project Management, involving the control and planning of construction projects. Main Courses for Civil Engineering The following key courses are offered during the first period of 3 years Engineering Mechanics Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.
